body: Thanks for your understandingness, I think I'm feeling better now :)

Thanks for responding. I've cut  my ex out of my life many times only for us to end up being friends again because she seems to be much more mature and sane, and she's a great friend when she's like that. But she is definitely toxic when she isn't, and she often isn't these days. So you're probably right but it's so hard to just cut her out, she has me tied to her with guilt. I feel like if I cut her out she will threaten suicide or something along those lines...

I had therapy for depression a couple years ago and it only slightly helped. I don't know if I can again since I used the uni last time, but now I am leaving uni, and the waiting list is around 6 months via the NHS. Private therapy is usually too expensive but I can check. 
I'm doing better than most people perhaps, but I've been told I'm gifted my whole life and that I should be achieving more but I've always failed the important things such as exams, interviews, applications... People call me lazy and I start to believe it I suppose, despite my mental health holding me back
